title: Duquesne Whistle
original_lyrics:
[intro]
Listen to that Duquesne whistle blowing

[bridge]
I wanna stop at Carmbondale and keep on going
That Duquesne train goin' rock me night and day
You say I'm gambler, you say I'm pimp

[bridge]
Listen to that Duquesne whistle blowing
Sounding like it's on final run
Listen to that Duquesne whistle blowing

[bridge]
Little light blinking, red light glowing

[bridge]
You smiling through the fence at me
Just like you always smiled before
Listen to that Duquesne whistle blowing

[bridge]
You're the only thing alive that keeps me going
You're like time bomb in my heart
I can hear sweet voice steadily calling
Must be the mother of our Lord
Listen to that Duquesne whistle blowing

[bridge]
Listen to that Duquesne whistle blowing

[bridge]
You old rascal, I know exactly where you're going
I'll lead you there myself at the break of day
I wake up every morning with that woman in my bed
Everybody telling me she's gone to my head
Listen to that Duquesne whistle blowing

[bridge]
The lights on my native land are glowing
I wonder if they'll know me next time 'round
I wonder if that old oak tree's still standing
That old oak tree, the one we used to climb
Listen to that Duquesne whistle blowing
